fixed_on: 2026-09-29; revised 2026-09-30 for decisions D9 to D12 before the first run of the revised protocol

protocol.time_error_removal: Decision D10. The spatial study runs every level at 128 steps per inviscid period. The time error at that step is estimated from the time-step study as e_time = (4/3) (e(128) - e(256)) (second-order scheme; the observed temporal order is reported) and subtracted from every spatial frequency error. The damping and volume criteria use the spatial runs directly: the generalized-alpha damping at 128 steps per period is 1e-6 omega, about 0.02% of the physical rate.
protocol.note: Runs with another level-set velocity or mean depth are reported as comparisons and never gated. Definitions and the reference solution are in README.md.

criteria.definition: |omega/omega_ref - 1 - e_time| on the spatial study, with omega fitted to the free-surface elevation history at the left-wall probe (x = 0) as eta(t) = c + exp(-gamma t) (a cos(omega t) + b sin(omega t)) over all outputs, omega_ref = Im(s) of the linear viscous standing wave with free-slip walls, and e_time the time error of the spatial-study step from the time-step study (README.md)
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(L/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M1 working criterion: frequency error <= 1% at the finest mesh with observed convergence ('observed convergence' read as a strictly decreasing error with an observed order of at least 1, as for M2 in static_drop_2d); decision D10: judged with the time-step error removed

criteria.definition: |gamma - gamma_ref| / gamma_ref at L/h = 64 on the spatial study, gamma from the same fit and gamma_ref = -Re(s) of the linear viscous standing wave (README.md)
criteria.source: Decision D12: sloshing damping error <= 5% at the finest level, matching the capillary-wave criterion

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), A the exact area of {phi_h < 0} and A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu, on every run of the protocol (spatial and time-step studies)
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M1 working criterion (volume drift <= 1e-4 over the run); decision D11: the maximum deviation over the run, including reversible oscillation of the P1 area
